# IAAF26: 9th International Ancient Arts Festival 2026

> IAAF26 (also written IAAF 26 or IAAF 2026) is the 9th International Ancient Arts Festival: two evenings of Indian classical and folk dance and classical music at Kamani Auditorium, Mandi House, New Delhi, on 25 and 26 November 2026, from 6:30 pm. It is presented by Rays of Wisdom Society and curated and directed by Dr. Reela Hota. This is the festival's official page. It is not related to the IAAF that was the former name of World Athletics.

## Key facts
- Dates: 25 and 26 November 2026, from 6:30 pm (India Standard Time)
- Venue: Kamani Auditorium, 1 Copernicus Marg, Mandi House, New Delhi 110001 (nearest metro: Mandi House, Blue and Violet lines)
- First evening (25 November), Classical and Folk Dance: Sanskrit: The Mantra Bhasha (Odissi and classical ballet), Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi, and Indian Kathak meets the Russian folk circle dance Sudarushka
- Second evening (26 November), Classical Music: santoor and rabab, with pakhawaj and tabla, then a Hindustani classical vocal recital in the Banaras Gharana tradition
- Artists, first evening: Dr. Reela Hota (Odissi), Joe Mathew (ballet), Princess Panigrahi and Priyanka Das, Arupa Lahiri (Bharatanatyam), Amrita Lahiri (Kuchipudi), Gauri Diwakar (Kathak) with Mariia Timashova, Mariia Agafonova and Yana (Sudarushka)
- Artists, second evening: Pandit Abhay Rustum Sopori (santoor), Pandit Mukesh Sharma (rabab), Pandit Ritesh Mishra and Pandit Rajnish Mishra (Banaras Gharana vocal)
- Ancient Arts Award 2026: Padma Shri Madhavi Mudgal
- Entry: make an e-pass on the festival page and show it at the gate (one pass admits up to 4 people)
- Organiser: Rays of Wisdom Society, https://www.raysofwisdomsociety.net
- Contact: Nishant Sharma, Project Coordinator, +91 89555 91445; office +91 99538 24452; raysofwisdom@gmail.com
